claims.text: Immunocompetent pts w visceral involvement or severe/persistent Sx: pyrimethamine + sulfadiazine for 2 to 4 wks,
claims.quote: The most effective regimen in immunocompetent patients with visceral involvement or severe or persistent symptoms is pyrimethamine plus sulfadiazine, for 2 to 4 weeks.

claims.quote: Leucovorin (folinic acid) is given concurrently to help protect against bone marrow suppression.

claims.text: Sulfonamide hypersensitivity: clindamycin w pyrimethamine and leucovorin instead.
claims.quote: In patients who have or develop sulfonamide hypersensitivity, clindamycin is given with pyrimethamine and leucovorin instead of sulfonamides.
